winConditions.title: Deliver the Finishing Blow
text: If you attack your opponent's Leader and deal damage when they have 0 Life cards remaining, you win the game.
This is the primary win condition — reduce the opponent's Life to zero, then land one final hit.

winConditions.title: Empty Deck
text: If a player has 0 cards in their deck, they lose the game at the next rule processing check.
This is checked continuously — as soon as a player's deck runs out, they meet a defeat condition.

winConditions.title: Concession
text: Either player may concede at any time. Announce your concession and you lose immediately.
Concession is not affected by any card effect and cannot be forced by any card either.
